subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this PR be narrowed to the wired pruning/summary changes, or should it be expanded into a complete production multi-pass compaction integration before merge?
rationale: The current branch contains useful compaction ideas, but the largest new multi-pass surface is not reachable from production and the correct owner boundary for multi-pass session-state behavior needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Remove the unused multi-pass helper/settings surface, keep only production-wired compaction changes, and fix the recent-turn pruning boundary with focused tests.

options.title: Complete Multi-Pass Integration
options.body: Wire the helper through the real compaction callers and require session-state, timeout, provider-fallback, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For Architecture Issue
options.body: Keep this PR open or close/reopen around the canonical compaction architecture discussion if maintainers want the broader design settled first.

recommendation.title: Narrow Before Merge
recommendation.body: Remove the unused multi-pass helper/settings surface, keep only production-wired compaction changes, and fix the recent-turn pruning boundary with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is assigned on the live PR and can route the product-direction choice to the right compaction owner if needed.
